## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
- Unflagged tier-4 biopsy with 0% invasive probability [F1] and validated stroma, though the top normal-lobules concept is unreliable.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0%, Benign 0% | Strongly favors Normal over InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 98%, OOD 94%, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged input; moderate AUROC (0.70) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%); 1 Benign (BACH_0302) [F5] | Mostly Normal; one Benign neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.57, contribution -1.61) [F2]; unreliable 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Low score (-0.48, contribution +0.88) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.26, contribution -0.55) [F4]; 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei counts** (regions 0, 7, 8) · context · Zero neoplastic/epithelial nuclei (1 connective, 2 dead); insufficient tumor nuclei · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 8 (0.89), 7 (0.69), and 0 (0.51) contain scant atypical cells despite insufficient segmented tumor nuclei.
- Benign proliferation (like neighbor BACH_0302, differing in duct-confined cells and tubules) or in-situ disease (2%) is misclassified.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 7, 0**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (0.89, 0.69, 0.51) where HoVer-Net found 1 connective and 2 dead nuclei.
2. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Verify normal two-layered lobules directly, as the normal-lobules concept is unreliable (0/20 spot-check).
3. **Regions 1, 5, 11**: Confirm benign stroma/fat and check ducts/tubules (regions 5, 11) against Benign neighbor BACH_0302.
